notes:
Nissan and Infiniti cars on the diagnostic socket's CAN pair (pins 6 and 14, 11-bit identifiers, 500 kbit/s): Qashqai J11 (2013 to 2021), Juke F15 (2010 to 2019) and X-Trail T32 (2014 to 2021). The same addresses appear for the Rogue and the Infiniti Q50 and QX50 in the sources, which is the only evidence for Infiniti.

Every address is a fact transcribed from open diagnostic-tool sources; no signal definition is copied. Treat every row as unconfirmed until `obd-read probe` shows the unit answering.

The response offset is not always 8. opendbc states a receive offset of 0x20 for Nissan units and OBDb agrees for 0x740, 0x743, 0x744, 0x748, 0x758 and 0x75C, but the engine and transmission answer at the legislated offset of 8 (0x7E0 to 0x7E8, 0x7E1 to 0x7E9) and 0x723 answers at 0x735, an offset of 0x12. Each unit therefore names its own response identifier.

Service is per unit. opendbc opens a Nissan unit with session 0x81 and reads its software version with service 21 identifier 0x83, so the profile defaults to KWP2000 with session 0x81. OBDb shows only service 22 (two-byte identifiers) for 0x723 and 0x748, which therefore carry UDS with session 0x01.

Some units sit on 29-bit identifiers (a gateway at 0x18DAD0F1 in opendbc, and OBDb headers DA15, DA18, DA2D, DADA and DADB). A profile has one identifier width, so they are in `nissan-infiniti-can-29bit`.

A vendor handout lists a Nissan secure gateway from 2020, which is not documented in any source here. A unit that stays silent on a newer car is reported as no response, not as a fault.

Session caveat: no source shows a Leaf, Qashqai, Juke or X-Trail unit accepting the session this profile opens. opendbc sends 10 81 and then 21 83 to Nissan units only to fingerprint their software version, and OBDb's Leaf file sets diagnosticLevel C0, which the guard does not allow, so the profile does not use it. Session 0x81 (KWP2000) and 0x01 (UDS) are guard-permitted values chosen from that evidence and are unconfirmed; confirming them on a real car is tracked in https://github.com/Mearman/obd/issues/70.
